methodologyNotes: 13 notable e-readers compared by buyers in 2026. Specs sourced from manufacturer product pages (BOOX shop.boox.com), Wikipedia device articles, and independent reviews (Digital Trends, GoodEReader, AndroidAuthority). US MSRP / launch price used; where prices changed after launch the launch price is noted. Battery life in weeks reflects manufacturer claim or reviewer-confirmed figure; null where no credible week-count was found. Waterproof = true only for certified IP ratings (IPX8); water-repellent designs = false. Color E Ink panels noted via color_display boolean. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Kindle (2024)
products.priceNote: Base price with lock-screen ads; $129.99 without ads. US MSRP at launch Oct 2024.
products.provenance: Battery life (6 weeks) and waterproof/warm-light status confirmed via Digital Trends review. Screen size, PPI, storage, and release date confirmed via Wikipedia Kindle article.

products.name: Kindle Paperwhite (2024)
products.priceNote: Base 16 GB model with ads at US launch. Signature Edition (32 GB, wireless charging) is $199.99.
products.provenance: Battery 12 weeks, IPX8, $160 price from Digital Trends review. Screen 7", 300 ppi, 16 GB storage from Wikipedia. Warm light (adjustable color temperature) confirmed in review text.

products.name: Kindle Colorsoft Signature Edition (2024)
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch Oct 30 2024. Only config is Signature Edition (32 GB, wireless charging). A $249.99 / 16 GB standard model launched July 2025.
products.provenance: Battery 8 weeks, IPX8, $280 price from Digital Trends review. 300 ppi (B&W) / 150 ppi (color) Kaleido 3, 7" screen, 32 GB from Wikipedia. Warm light confirmed in review. Release date Oct 30 2024 from Wikipedia.

products.name: Kindle Scribe (2024)
products.priceNote: Base 16 GB model at US launch Dec 4 2024. 32 GB = $419.99, 64 GB = $449.99.
products.provenance: Battery 12 weeks, warm light confirmed via Digital Trends review of 2024 model. 10.2", 300 ppi, $399.99 base 16 GB price, Dec 4 2024 release from Wikipedia. Includes Basic Pen stylus. Not waterproof: the Kindle Scribe has no IP rating (verified via SlashGear waterproof-Kindle breakdown and ScreenRant); only Paperwhite and Colorsoft among current Kindles are IPX8. Prior claim of an added IPX8 rating was incorrect and has been corrected to waterproof=false.

products.name: Kobo Clara BW
products.priceNote: US launch price April 2024. Price increased ~$10 globally in Feb 2025.
products.provenance: 6", 300 ppi (E Ink Carta 1300 HD), 16 GB, IPX8, ComfortLight PRO, no page-turn buttons, $129.99 launch from Wikipedia; battery 1500 mAh, 174 g. Kobo officially rates the Clara BW at up to 53 days (30 min/day, light 10%, wireless off) per the Rakuten Kobo store, i.e. ~7.5 weeks; recorded as 7 weeks.

products.name: Kobo Clara Colour
products.provenance: 6", Kaleido 3 (300 ppi B&W / 150 ppi color), 16 GB, IPX8, 6 weeks battery, $149.99 launch from GoodEReader article. Wikipedia corroborates April 2024 release, 300/150 ppi, 16 GB. Weight 174 g.

products.name: Kobo Libra Colour
products.priceNote: US launch price April 2024. Increased to ~$229.99 after Feb 2025 global price rise.
products.provenance: 7", Kaleido 3 (300/150 ppi), 32 GB, IPX8, ComfortLight PRO, page-turn buttons, ~40 days battery (rounded to 6 weeks), $219.99 launch from GoodEReader. Wikipedia corroborates 300/150 ppi, IPX8, 2050 mAh, page-turn buttons, April 2024.

products.name: Kobo Libra 2
products.provenance: 7", E Ink Carta 1200 HD (300 ppi), 32 GB, IPX8, ComfortLight PRO, page-turn buttons, $179.99 from Wikipedia. Battery 1420 mAh; weeks not stated in sources reviewed.

products.name: Kobo Sage
products.provenance: 8" (1920×1440 = 300 ppi calculated), 32 GB, IPX8, ComfortLight PRO, page-turn buttons, $259.99 from Wikipedia. Battery 1200 mAh; weeks-based rating not confirmed by sources. Compatible with Kobo Stylus (sold separately). Corroboration URL returned 404; primary source is Wikipedia.

products.name: Kobo Elipsa 2E
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch April 2023, includes Kobo Stylus 2.
products.provenance: 10.3", 227 ppi (1404×1872), 32 GB, ComfortLight PRO from Wikipedia. Waterproof status not mentioned by Wikipedia or Digital Trends review; set to false (unknown = not confirmed waterproof). Battery 2400 mAh; weeks not stated. Includes Kobo Stylus 2. Release April 19 2023 from Wikipedia.

products.name: Boox Page
products.priceNote: US MSRP $249.99 from official BOOX shop (shop.boox.com), corroborated by Best Buy listing.

products.priceNote: US retail MSRP $279.99 at launch (initial pre-order bundle $249.99 with a free case). Superseded by Palma 2 ($249.99) in Oct 2024.

products.name: Boox Palma 2

Release October 2024 from Wikipedia. Battery 3950 mAh; weeks not stated.
